H.prompt_expected: Lift the green fruit higher and keep holding it.

T.prompt: Move the green fruit toward the blue object and keep holding it.

prompts.blue: Move the green fruit toward the blue mark and keep holding it.

F.prompt: Pick up the green fruit, lift it above the table and keep holding it.
